sample_unit: clinical notes (3,245 from 125 individuals in BGR; 5,462 from 260 individuals in CP clinic)

links.outcome: LLM extraction accuracy of verbal and ambulatory ability across two institutional cohorts
links.effect: Ambulatory weighted-F1 >.90 in both cohorts; verbal ability predictions were more accurate in the BGR cohort than in the CP clinic cohort.
links.quote: However, verbal ability predictions were more accurate in the BGR cohort, likely due to higher adherence between the prompt and ground-truth assessment questions.

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks the accuracy of three LLMs (GPT-3.5 Turbo, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-4 Omni) for extracting functional biomarkers (verbal and ambulatory ability) from retrospective EHR clinical notes against ground truth assessments.
